Comparing with common LCD screens on market, TRYX AMOLED screen offers 372PPI pixel density and 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio for stunning visual experience. Additionally, the PANORAMA SE 360 ARGB 360mm AIO cooler features a rotatable screen design which allows multi-adjustable positions of the screen to fit new preselection "Waterfall" 3D animation
  • 3D ANAMORPHIC EFFECT: The TRYX PANORAMA SE 360 ARGB AIO cooler 360mm still has the iconic curved AMOLED screen which enhances the depth of displayed contents, coupled with custom-formatted 3D videos, it achieves stunning 3D visual effects that can be seen with naked-eye. Multiple preloaded contents including the new "Waterfall" 3D animation especially for PANORAMA SE Series can be found in the 3D content Library in KANALI software, it will be continuously updated to enrich the 3D anamorphic effect experience
  • RELIABLE SCREEN TECH: The curved screen of TRYX PANORAMA SE 360 ARGB AIO cooler designed by “G2 Curvature” for enhancing viewing angles and immersion to offer more engaging visual experience; The tempered glass cover offers reliable resistance and durability to prevent scratches and drops. Meanwhile, TRYX uses full adhesion technology to eliminates air gaps by seamlessly bonding the screen with the glass layer, which higher light transmittance and reduced reflection for clearer and more detailed visuals without backlight bleeding issue
  • ASETEK COOLING SOLUTION: PANORAMA SE 360 ARGB 360mm AIO features ASETEK's new generation cooling solution——Adela, which easily handles CPU-intensive tasks like software compilation, video encoding, AI-related works and gaming etc. Combining with a high-density fins radiator and cooling fans, PANORAMA SE 360 ARGB 360mm AIO provides overall 280w TDP cooling capacity to achieve lasting efficiency and stable performance for working/gaming requirements
  • ULTIMATE CUSTOMIZATION: Utilize the TRYX KANALI software to customize your PANORAMA SE 360 ARGB AIO cooler 360mm display with Instant Screen Content Switching. Split-Screen Display Capability and System Info. while using near-zero system resources for the ultimate customization experience. Users can upload and adjust their own media to display including PNG/JPG/GIF/MP4/AVI (1080P, 500M maximum), which sparks creativity and provides various ways to showcase the best visual effect with boundless imagination
  • HIGH COMPATIBILITY: The included all-metal mounting hardware in PANORAMA SE 360 ARGB 360mm liquid cooler CPU box gives reliable installation that ensures proper contact and equal pressure on Intel LGA 1851/1700/1200/1151/1150/1155 and AMD AM4/AM5
  • STABILITY AND QUIET OPERATION: TRYX PANORAMA SE 360 ARGB 360mm AIO comes with three 120mm pre-installed ROTA ARGB fans which feature fluid dynamic bearing and ARGB GEN2 LEDs for long-lasting stability. ROTA ARGB fans are equipped with dumping pads in four corners to minimize noise caused by vibration and build quiet operation under 27.86dB(A) even in full load

The slightly convex design ensures optimal contact with your CPU’s integrated heat spreader, with thermal paste applied in an optimized pattern to speed up installation.

Minimize cable-clutter in your system by daisy-chaining your RS fans to a single 4-pin PWM header on your motherboard.

SHH… SILENT POWER
